cc:Work.dc:description: USTEC2 Discovery: 29 Jan 2020–30 Nov 2024 signals; December 2024 burnoff. Star = frozen 10:15 / OR60 LONG medoid. Frozen flags copied from selection records. Neighbouring cells share history and trades; qualification is not independent validation.
